content: When NmStateReportEnabled is set to TRUE , Nm_StateChangeNotification shall call Com_SendSignal(uint8, Com_SignalIdType, const void * ) with NmStateReportSignalRef as Com_SignalIdType . NmStateReportSignalRef points to a 6 bit signal, called Network Management State (NMS). The NMS needs to be configuered in Com .
